about: Replication counts from FORRT's Replication Database (FReD), matched to this corpus by exact normalised effect name. Every match carries its attempt count; the signal/no-signal split appears only where FReD has computed an outcome for at least 3 of them.
cite: FORRT Replication Database (FReD), Röseler et al., Journal of Open Psychology Data. CC BY 4.0.

rejected.Certainty effect: matched our Allais Paradox entry. The certainty effect is the mechanism Allais's problem exposes, not the paradox itself — close enough to match on a normalised string and not close enough to publish.
